name: Rf Bridge → On Code Received
description:
An action to be performed when a code is received. See [`on_code_received` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/rf_bridge/#rf_bridge-on_code_received).

With this configuration option you can write complex automations whenever a code is received by the bridge. To use the code, use a [lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates/#config-lambda) template. The code and the corresponding protocol timings are available inside that lambda under the variables named `code`, `sync`, `high` and `low`.
